card.title: Plant Manager
card.description:
***Position Summary***

The Plant Manager is responsible for the overall day-to-day leadership and performance of the machine shop operation. This position provides hands-on leadership across machining, production, quality, maintenance, safety, scheduling, and employee development to ensure the facility consistently meets customer requirements for safety, quality, delivery, cost, and productivity.

The Plant Manager will drive operational excellence through Lean Manufacturing, continuous improvement, standardized work, effective production planning, and development of a high-performing manufacturing team. This individual will partner closely with Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain, and other functional leaders to support business growth and achieve operational objectives.

***Essential Functions / Responsibilities*****:**

**Operations Leadership**

* Provide overall leadership and direction for daily machine shop operations.
* Manage production activities to achieve customer delivery, quality, productivity, and cost objectives.
* Establish and monitor daily, weekly, and monthly production goals.
* Ensure effective production scheduling, machine loading, labor utilization, and workflow.
* Identify and resolve production constraints, bottlenecks, and capacity issues.
* Ensure appropriate staffing and resource allocation to meet production requirements.
* Maintain strong floor presence and lead through visible, hands-on management.

**Machining & Manufacturing**

* Oversee CNC machining, manual machining, secondary operations, assembly, plating, Injection molding, deburring, inspection, and related manufacturing activities.
* Ensure equipment, tooling, fixtures, and processes are capable of meeting production requirements.
* Partner with Manufacturing Engineering to improve machining processes, cycle times, setups, tooling, and machine loading.
* Drive setup reduction, machine utilization, labor efficiency, and throughput improvements.
* Ensure adherence to standardized work and documented manufacturing processes.
* Lead Hazardous Waste Coordinator for facility.

**Lean Manufacturing & Continuous Improvement**

* Lead Lean Manufacturing and continuous improvement initiatives throughout the machine shop.
* Implement and sustain 5S, visual management, standard work, waste reduction, and problem-solving methodologies.
* Identify opportunities to reduce scrap, rework, setup time, downtime, and overall manufacturing costs.
* Utilize data and KPIs to identify root causes and drive corrective actions.
* Establish a culture of continuous improvement and employee involvement.

**Safety & Environmental**

* Maintain a strong safety culture and ensure compliance with OSHA and company safety requirements.
* Lead safety initiatives, audits, training, and corrective actions.
* Ensure proper machine guarding, PPE, lockout/tagout, housekeeping, and safe operating practices.
* Investigate incidents and near misses and implement appropriate corrective actions.
* Hold employees and leaders accountable for safe work practices.

**Quality**

* Partner with Quality to ensure products meet customer and internal quality requirements.
* Drive reduction of scrap, rework, defects, and customer complaints.
* Ensure operators follow documented work instructions and quality procedures.
* Participate in root-cause analysis and corrective/preventive action activities.
* Promote a culture of first-time quality and process ownership.

**People Leadership**

* Lead, coach, and develop supervisors, leads, machinists, operators, and other production personnel.
* Establish clear performance expectations and accountability.
* Support recruiting, onboarding, training, cross-training, and employee development.
* Develop a flexible, multi-skilled workforce capable of supporting changing production requirements.
* Conduct performance reviews and address performance issues in a timely manner.
* Foster teamwork, communication, accountability, and employee engagement.

**Maintenance & Equipment**

* Partner with Maintenance to maximize equipment availability and reliability.
* Monitor machine downtime and establish corrective action plans.
* Support preventive and predictive maintenance programs.
* Manage capital equipment planning, justification and implementation.
* Ensure new equipment and processes are effectively integrated into production.

**Financial & Business Performance**

* Manage operational performance against established budgets and financial targets.
* Monitor labor efficiency, overtime, scrap, rework, material usage, and machine utilization.
* Identify and execute cost-reduction opportunities.
* Support Supplier Development Activities
* Support Product Transfer activities which may include travel
* Drive capital expenditure planning and return-on-investment analysis.
* Understand the relationship between operational performance, cost, and EBITDA.

**Communication & Cross-Functional Leadership**

* Conduct daily/weekly operational meetings and communicate priorities throughout the organization.
* Provide leadership with clear reporting on production performance, capacity, quality, safety, and staffing.
* Work closely with Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain, Purchasing, and Sales to resolve issues and support customer requirements.
* Escalate operational risks and develop action plans to address them.

***Physical Requirements*****:**

Required to sit, stand, bend, and lift up to 25 lbs.

***Work Environment*****:**

* Combination of Manufacturing and Office environment.
* Regular exposure to noise, dust, heat, cold and odors.

***Knowledge, Skills & Experiences*****:**

* Bachelor's degree in Manufacturing, Engineering, Operations, or related field preferred.
* 7+ years of progressive manufacturing experience, preferably in a precision machining environment.
* 3+ years of manufacturing leadership experience with responsibility for people and operational performance.
* Strong knowledge of CNC machining and machine shop operations.
* Experience with high-mix/low- to medium-volume manufacturing preferred.
* Strong understanding of Lean Manufacturing and continuous improvement principles.
* Demonstrated experience leading production teams and improving operational performance.
* Strong knowledge of manufacturing safety practices and OSHA requirements.
* Experience with ERP/MRP systems and production scheduling.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
* Excellent communication and leadership abilities.

***Preferred Experience***

* Precision machining and tight-tolerance manufacturing
* CNC turning and milling
* Multi-axis machining
* High-mix manufacturing
* AS9100, ISO 9001, or other regulated manufacturing environments
* Hazardous Waste Management

* Lean/Six Sigma methodologies
* ERP/MRP systems
* Capital equipment implementation
* Continuous improvement / Kaizen
* P&L or operating-budget responsibility

card.description:
**Job Description**

**General/Position Summary**

 

The Quality Assurance Senior Operational Manager is recognized as an expert internally in the principles and application of quality assurance and compliance. The Quality Snr Manager will provide QA support of manufacturing operations, analytical laboratory operations and materials management for the external manufacture of Cell & Genetic Therapeutic programs. This role will drive, review & support activities related to product disposition including review of batch data, batch records, deviations, in-process data, EM data, QC release testing and other quality systems documentation.

 

**Key Duties & Responsibilities**

* Responsible for quality support of Vertex Cell and Gene Therapy manufacturing operations across all phases of development, support of analytical laboratory, materials management and manufacturing operations.

* Responsible for GMP batch disposition activities including review and approval of batch records, deviations, in-process data, EM data, QC release testing, materials review board and other quality activities as applicable to determine acceptability of product disposition.

* Partner with External CDMOs

* Provide QA support of change controls, process and OOS investigations, and associated CAPAs.

* Responsible for approval of COAs and product labelling.

* Support review and approval of manufacturing documents such as technical and analytical protocols/reports

* Support technical transfer, and process performance qualification activities.

* Responsible for identifying compliance risks and gaps for GMP processes and supporting implementation of mitigating controls

* Support audit and inspection readiness activities.

* Act as a trusted advisor by providing compliance guidance through collaborative review and partnering with business stakeholders and contract manufacturers.

* Support the vendor management process including the creation and review of Quality Agreements with suppliers.

* Assist with addressing product complaints

* Maintain periodic batch record metrics and assists department with routine/quarterly Quality System data review metrics and reporting

* Execute improvements to QA operations procedure.

* Participate/ lead Cell & Genetic Program and Quality projects and drive continuous improvement activities.

 

**Required Education Level**

* Bachelor's degree in a biotech/ Lifesciences field.

* Preferred Master's degree or relevant comparable background.

 

**Required Experience**

8+ years of relevant industry experience such as manufacturing, quality assurance, and/or quality control in biotechnology/regulated pharmaceutical environment.

 

**Required Knowledge/Skills**

* Demonstrated experience providing QA support to GMP manufacturing operation
* Experience successfully leading event investigations, Root Cause Analysis and CAPA
* Experience with network-based applications such as Oracle, TrackWise, Veeva
* In-depth knowledge of both the conceptual and practical application of cGMPs in a pharmaceutical setting; Biotech/Cell & Gene GMP regulations and applicability. (e.g. EU, FDA, ICH, USP, etc. or other industry best practices ex. ISPE, WHO, etc.)
* Knowledge in Cell technology, aseptic manufacturing technology, analytical assays, cell & genetic therapies/Biologics processing, fill/finish and testing.
* Professional membership or equivalent in relevant societies, network of knowledge in cell and gene therapy industry.
* Ability to evaluate quality matters and make decisions utilizing risk-based approach
Ability to independently lead cross-functional teams, and effectively communicate with business stakeholders. 

 

**Other Requirements**

Up to 15% Travel may be required 

 
 

At Vertex, we embrace continuous learning and encourage employees to stay informed on advances in AI, technology, automation, and industry trends. We seek talent who bring an external perspective, demonstrate curiosity and sound judgment, and thoughtfully adopt new capabilities that improve decision-making, drive innovation, increase efficiency, and help deliver better outcomes for patients.

**Pay Range:**

$133,800 - $200,600

**Disclosure Statement:**

The range provided is based on what we believe is a reasonable estimate for the base salary pay range for this job at the time of posting. This role is eligible for an annual bonus and annual equity awards. Some roles may also be eligible for overtime pay, in accordance with federal and state requirements. Actual base salary pay will be based on a number of factors, including skills, competencies, experience, and other job-related factors permitted by law.

At Vertex, our Total Rewards offerings also include inclusive market-leading benefits to meet our employees wherever they are in their career, financial, family and wellbeing journey while providing flexibility and resources to support their growth and aspirations. From medical, dental and vision benefits to generous paid time off (including a week-long company shutdown in the Summer and the Winter), educational assistance programs including student loan repayment, a generous commuting subsidy, matching charitable donations, 401(k) and so much more.

**Flex Designation:**

Hybrid-Eligible Or On-Site Eligible

**Flex Eligibility Status:**

In this Hybrid-Eligible role, you can choose to be designated as:
 
1. **Hybrid** : work remotely up to two days per week; **or select** 
2. **On-Site** : work five days per week on-site with ad hoc flexibility.

Note: The Flex status for this position is subject to Vertex’s Policy on Flex @ Vertex Program and may be changed at any time.

#LI-Hybrid

**Company Information**

Vertex is a global biotechnology company that invests in scientific innovation.

Vertex is committed to equal employment opportunity and non-discrimination for all employees and qualified applicants without regard to a person's race, color, sex, gender identity or expression, age, religion, national origin, ancestry, ethnicity, disability, veteran status, genetic information, sexual orientation, marital status, or any characteristic protected under applicable law. Vertex is an E-Verify Employer in the United States. Vertex will make reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with known disabilities, in accordance with applicable law.

Any applicant requiring an accommodation in connection with the hiring process and/or to perform the essential functions of the position for which the applicant has applied should make a request to the recruiter or hiring manager, or contact Talent Acquisition at ApplicationAssistance@vrtx.com

**JOB DESCRIPTION**

**POSITION TITLE:**

**Director of Quality and Population Health**

**POSITION SUMMARY:**

The Director of Quality and Population Health leads CHCFC’s Quality Improvement and Population Health programs, with accountability for program planning, implementation, and evaluation. The Director works across departments to improve patient outcomes, access, and health equity; leads measurable improvement initiatives; and oversees quality reporting. The position directly supervises Population Health staff and independently manages program priorities and follow-through within plans approved by the Chief Medical Officer.

**REPORTS TO:**

Chief Medical Officer

**FLSA STATUS:**

Exempt

**PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**1. Lead Quality Improvement and Performance Management**

* Develops quality and population health priorities and the annual Performance Management Plan in collaboration with the Quality Council and other leaders for Chief Medical Officer approval; leads implementation and evaluates progress toward established goals.
* Leads monthly Performance Management meetings; establishes reporting expectations with Quality Champions, reviews measures, and ensures improvement plans have clear owners, timelines, and follow-through.
* Coaches teams in practical improvement methods, including setting measurable goals, testing workflow changes, and evaluating whether changes improve results.
* Provides staff training and presents clear reports and recommendations to leadership and relevant committees; independently addresses routine program barriers and escalates unresolved issues, resource needs, and major decisions to the Chief Medical Officer.

**2. Manage Population Health Programs and Staff**

* Recruits, hires, orients, supervises, and evaluates Population Health staff; establishes priorities, monitors workloads, and supports staff development and accountability.
* Oversees outreach, patient registries, and workflows that support preventive care, chronic disease management, and closure of care gaps.
* Coordinates with Medical, Behavioral Health, Nursing, Operations, and other teams to integrate population health activities into daily workflows and reduce avoidable duplication.
* Uses population data to identify disparities and barriers to care and works with teams to improve outreach and access for underserved patients.

**3. Oversee Quality Data and Reporting**

* Oversees a calendar of quality reporting requirements, measure definitions, data sources, responsible staff, and deadlines; follows up with contributors to ensure timely, accurate completion of program deliverables.
* Works with IT and other data partners to develop and validate reports, registries, and dashboards; investigates discrepancies and supports consistent data collection and documentation.
* Analyzes trends and presents actionable findings to support priorities, resource decisions, and evaluation of improvement efforts.
* Shares responsibility for annual Uniform Data System (UDS) reporting with IT, Finance, and other designated contributors; coordinates the quality and clinical measures within the Director’s scope, supports validation, and completes assigned reporting deliverables.
* Coordinates other assigned HRSA, payer, accountable care organization, and program quality reporting with the appropriate organizational leads.

**4. Lead PCMH Activities and Cross Department Collaboration**

* Serves as the primary coordinator for Patient-Centered Medical Home (PCMH) recognition and ongoing reporting, maintains documentation and timelines, and works with departments to meet applicable requirements.
* Leads improvement work across departments in collaboration with clinical and operational leaders; translates quality priorities into feasible workflows, establishes shared responsibilities and timelines, and evaluates whether improvements are sustained.
* Participates in relevant meetings, training, and professional development and performs other duties as assigned, consistent with the position’s responsibilities and qualifications.

**REQUIRED SKILLS, EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE**

**Education**

* Bachelor’s degree in public health, health administration, a related field, or an equivalent combination of relevant education and experience. A master’s degree in a related field is preferred. Clinical training or licensure is not required.

**Experience**

* Minimum of three years of relevant experience in healthcare quality improvement, population health, or healthcare performance management, with demonstrated success independently leading improvement initiatives and managing program deliverables.
* Experience collecting, validating, analyzing, and presenting healthcare performance data.
* Supervisory or substantial cross-department team leadership experience required; direct staff supervision experience preferred.
* Experience in an FQHC, community health center, or other setting serving diverse and underserved populations preferred.
* Familiarity with PCMH, UDS, and value-based care quality measures preferred.

**Skills**

* Practical knowledge of continuous quality improvement methods and ability to help teams turn data into measurable improvements.
* Strong organizational and project management skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities and reporting deadlines.
* Proficiency with Excel and Microsoft Office; ability to use electronic health records, registries, and reporting tools. Familiarity with Epic preferred.
* Clear written and verbal communication, effective staff coaching, and collaborative leadership across departments.
* Ability to work respectfully with culturally, racially, ethnically, and gender diverse staff and patients and apply an equity perspective to quality and population health work.
* Sound judgment, integrity, and ability to maintain confidentiality and comply with CHCFC privacy and information security policies.

**Physical Demands:**

The physical demands described here are representative of those required to perform the essential functions of this position, with or without reasonable accommodation. Duties primarily involve sitting, computer use, reviewing electronic records and reports, and communicating with staff and leadership. The role also involves attending meetings and moving between work areas or CHCFC locations as needed.

**Working Conditions:**

Work is primarily performed in an office or health center setting, with travel between CHCFC locations as needed. Work arrangements are determined by organizational needs and CHCFC policies. Secure access to patient and organizational information is required, and confidential work must be conducted in a private setting using approved systems.

**Equal Employment Opportunity Statement:**

CHCFC is an Equal Opportunity Employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any protected status under federal or state law. CHCFC is committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace.

**Disclaimer:**

This job description reflects the general nature and level of work performed and is not intended to be an exhaustive list. It does not constitute an employment contract. Duties and responsibilities may be modified based on organizational needs.

**About Black Diamond Coatings (BDC Brands)**

Black Diamond Coatings, Inc. (BDC Brands) is a veteran- and family-owned manufacturer of premium, environmentally friendly home improvement products. Our DOMINATOR®, AQUA-X®, and OBSESS® brands are made in the USA and distributed through Amazon, Lowe’s, The Home Depot, Walmart, plus our own e-commerce site. Headquartered in Brooksville, Florida, we operate with an entrepreneurial spirit, high integrity, and a strong belief in teamwork, continuous improvement, and excellence.

**Mission:** Creating Trustworthy Solutions Beyond Expectations.

**Vision:** Our trusted brands deliver home improvement product solutions that “WOW” our DIY and Pro customers, setting the standard for quality and innovation.

**Position Summary**

The Executive Vice President, Innovation & Quality leads R&D, product innovation, quality, and regulatory compliance across the DOMINATOR®, AQUA-X®, and OBSESS® brands. Reporting to the CEO, this role owns BDC’s product development strategy and new-product pipeline, grows and protects our intellectual property, and owns our ISO 9001-certified quality system from formulation through shipment.

This is a builder’s role. The EVP sets technical direction, builds the team, and stays close enough to the bench to make fast, informed decisions. Innovation at BDC means shelf-ready products that win with our retail partners and customers, not open-ended research. Bold ideas are encouraged; products must be manufacturable, meet cost and quality targets, and ship on time.

**Champion BDC’s Core Values**

* Lead by example: demonstrate strong work ethic, integrity, and commitment to excellence in every interaction.
* Be resourceful and tenacious: do more with less, figure it out, and bring a relentless “will to win.”
* Stay positive as a team, communicate with honesty and respect, and hold yourself and others accountable to the BDC standard.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Innovation & Product Development**

* Set R&D strategy and own the product pipeline, aligned with company growth plans and retail partner priorities.
* Turn customer and market insight into products that outperform what is on the shelf, and expand the product line into new categories.
* Lead development of new, patentable technologies and protect BDC’s intellectual property.
* Run a disciplined, fast development process with clear go/no-go decisions.
* Improve the performance and cost of existing products, backed by solid test data.

**Quality**

* Own the quality system end to end and maintain ISO 9001 certification.
* Make quality a selling point with retail partners.

**Technical Support & Compliance**

* Oversee regulatory compliance and technical support so every product meets federal, state, and retailer requirements.

**Leadership & Partnership**

* Lead and develop the R&D, Quality, and Compliance teams through three direct reports.
* Partner with Operations to scale products from lab to full production.
* Work with Sales and Marketing on launches and retail buyer presentations.

**Job Qualifications**

**Required**

* Master’s or PhD in Chemistry, Polymer Science, Chemical Engineering, or a related field.
* 15+ years of product development in coatings, sealers, adhesives, cleaners, or specialty chemical consumer products, including 5+ years leading R&D teams.
* Proven record of taking products from concept to commercial launch, including developing patentable technology.
* Experience owning a QC/QA function under ISO 9001 or an equivalent quality management system.
* Deep expertise in water-based polymer and emulsion formulation; dry-blend experience is a plus.
* Hands-on lab skills and experience scaling products from lab to full production.
* Measured results using continuous improvement methods (Six Sigma, lean, or equivalent).
* Working knowledge of product regulatory requirements (SDS/GHS, VOC, EPA and state rules).
* Ability to travel approximately 10–15%.

**Preferred**

* Experience developing products for mass retail, including retailer testing and compliance.
* Category experience in home improvement, building products, or protective coatings.
* Experience building or scaling an R&D function in a growing, entrepreneurial company.
* Hands-on experience applying AI tools to R&D or quality work.

**Working Conditions**

On-site role based at BDC’s lab and manufacturing facility in Brooksville, FL. Regular laboratory work, including handling chemicals with appropriate PPE; outdoor field and application testing; and time on the production floor. Periodic travel to retail partners, suppliers, trade shows, and other BDC facilities.

Black Diamond Coatings, Inc. is an equal opportunity employer.

The Vice President, Quality Assurance (North America) is a full-time remote role responsible for overseeing all quality assurance activities related to Bento Amaral Wine Consulting’s services and partnerships in the North American market. This role includes designing and implementing quality management frameworks, defining standards and procedures, and monitoring adherence across consulting projects, educational programs, and content deliverables. The VP will lead quality audits, manage continuous improvement initiatives, and ensure compliance with relevant regulatory requirements and industry best practices. Day-to-day tasks involve collaborating with internal teams and external partners, reviewing processes and documentation, analyzing quality metrics, and providing guidance to ensure consistent, high-quality outcomes. The role also includes strategic input into service development, risk management, and client communications relating to quality assurance.

* Demonstrated expertise in Quality Assurance and Quality Management, with the ability to design and oversee robust quality systems.
* Strong skills in Quality Control, including setting quality standards, monitoring performance, and implementing corrective actions.
* Experience in Quality Auditing, with the capability to plan, conduct, and report internal and external audits.
* Solid understanding of applicable Regulatory Requirements and industry guidelines relevant to wine, food, or beverage sectors.
* Proven leadership experience in a senior quality role, ideally within wine, food, beverage, or related industries.
* Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills, with attention to detail and consistency.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work effectively in a remote, international environment.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Quality Management, Oenology, Food Science, Engineering, or a related field; professional certifications in quality (e.g., ISO, Six Sigma) are an advantage.
* Familiarity with North American regulatory and certification frameworks in wine, food, or beverage is highly beneficial.

**Our Mission & Vision:**
We connect the aviation industry through smart technology to make flight safer and more efficient, driving the future of aviation with intelligence and exceptional customer experiences.

**Our Values & Excellence Mindset:**
We are customer obsessed, trust-driven, owners of our work, stronger together, constantly curious, and boldly innovative.

**What You Will Experience in This Role:**

The Director - Quality Assurance drives quality across CAMP's Aircraft Health Management business and provides quality oversight for data and process quality concerns. The role owns the QMS, the internal audit program, and the full quality escape lifecycle, and serves as CAMP's quality voice with OEMs, regulators, and key customers. The right candidate combines deep aviation maintenance knowledge with a disciplined, data-driven approach to compliance and continuous improvement.

**Strategy & Leadership**

* Own and lead quality strategy across the full Aircraft Health Management organization, spanning maintenance tracking and engine health monitoring services, aligned with CAMP's business objectives.
* Serve as the escalation point for quality complaints from customer-facing, maintenance compliance, engine health monitoring, flight scheduling, and inventory functions.
* Partner with senior management and departmental leaders to embed quality methodologies across the organization and lead the associated change management.
* Own the quality budget, resource plan, and tooling (QMS, audit, and corrective action platforms), and build the succession pipeline for the quality team.

**Quality Management System & Certification**

* Own the Quality Management System (QMS) and quality SOPs, driving continuous improvement and ensuring processes meet strict regulatory and OEM requirements.
* Maintain ISO 9001 (or higher) certification for the engine health monitoring business, serving as external certification audit lead and ensuring ongoing audit readiness.
* Lead QMS management review with executive leadership, setting risk-based quality objectives and ensuring consistent QMS implementation (document control, competency records, data integrity) across all AHM locations in North America, Europe, and India.

**Audit & Compliance**

* Own the internal audit program end to end, including audit planning, execution, reporting, and the selection, training, and management of internal auditors.
* Host and manage OEM, customer, and third-party audits, driving findings to timely closure.

**Quality Escapes & Corrective Action**

* Manage all quality escapes from intake through investigation, root cause analysis, corrective and preventive action, and verification of effectiveness, with clear accountability to customers and OEM partners.
* Define and report corrective action performance metrics (e.g., escape rate, time to containment, on-time closure, recurrence) with clear thresholds and escalation paths.

**OEM & Customer Engagement**

* Facilitate and chair weekly, monthly, and quarterly strategic OEM meetings covering quality trends, KPI compliance, and corrective action status.
* Serve as primary quality liaison to OEM partners, regulatory bodies, and high-profile customers and large fleet operators under significant OEM contracts.
* Facilitate weekly, monthly, and quarterly quality reviews with senior management and functional leaders, translating escape, audit, and customer feedback data into trends and strategic quality initiatives.

**Continuous Improvement & Team Leadership**

* Lead process improvement using Lean Six Sigma methods, mentoring teams and driving measurable reductions in escapes, rework, and risk.
* Maintain an executive quality scorecard (customer feedback, escapes, audit results, corrective action performance) to drive data-based decisions.
* Lead, mentor, and develop a team of four, setting priorities and fostering a culture of excellence, accountability, and collaboration.
* Partner with AHM operations, training, and product leaders to ensure analyst competency, training effectiveness, and quality readiness for new products, processes, and teams.

**You have:**

* Bachelor's degree in Aerospace, Engineering, Quality Management, or a related field; advanced degree a plus.
* Minimum of 10 years of proven leadership experience in the aviation or aerospace sector, with senior quality assurance experience preferred.
* Strong working knowledge of aviation maintenance and its regulatory requirements (FAA, EASA, and OEM requirements). Hands-on aviation maintenance experience may offset formal credentials.
* Experience managing quality escapes, investigations, root cause analysis, and corrective action programs.
* Experience owning or managing a QMS in a regulated environment, with working knowledge of ISO 9001 (AS9100 familiarity a plus).
* Strong analytical skills, with the ability to turn quality data into executive-level metrics, insights, and recommendations.
* Excellent communication, negotiation, and presentation skills, with the ability to build relationships with OEMs, customers, and leaders at all levels of the organization.
* Strategic thinking with a strong focus on results and the ability to manage complex projects and initiatives.
* Ability to lead across a multi-site, multi-region team; willingness to travel to CAMP offices, OEM, and customer sites as needed.

**Nice to have:**

* Certified ISO 9001 Internal/External Auditor (or equivalent lead auditor certification) with hands-on audit experience.
* Six Sigma Black Belt, with demonstrated process improvement results.
* Quality manager certification (e.g., ASQ CQM) or Certified Quality Auditor (CQA) is a bonus.
* Experience working with large OEM contracts and high-profile customers or large fleet operators.
* Experience in aircraft maintenance tracking, engine trend monitoring, or other SaaS/data-driven service environments.

**Why Work at CAMP?**

Join a culture where your ideas matter, your impact is real, and your growth is supported. Be part of a team reimagining the future of aviation.

CAMP is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an affirmative action and equal opportunity employer - vets/disabled

CAMP is committed to providing access, equal opportunity, and reasonable accommodation for individuals with disabilities in employment, its services, programs, and activities. To request reasonable accommodation, please contact hr@campsystems.com.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status EEO.

**JOB SUMMARY:** Within the framework of the objectives and policies established by the Board of Directors of Franklin Primary Health Center, Inc., organizes and coordinates activities related to Healthcare Quality among all Franklin Primary Health Center’s clinical departments including Primary Care, Oral Health, Behavioral Health, Ryan White program, laboratory, performance improvement, etc. Plans and coordinates performance improvement activities in collaboration with the Deputy Director of Healthcare Quality Chief Medical Officer, Director of Nursing, Deputy Chief Operations Officer, Director of Behavioral Health, and Performance Improvement Manager. Participates in planning and policy formulation, with particular reference to the role, functions, and operations of the Center's clinical quality and performance improvement activities.

**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:**

* Coordinate and monitor clinical quality activities through the initiation of a clinical quality work plan that encompasses all clinical areas. Reports quarterly on the progress of the work plan to Chief Medical Officer. Coordinates an annual evaluation and update of the quality work plan.
* Works as a liaison between Franklin and other entities in matters pertaining to clinical quality and performance.
* Assists the Chief Medical Officer by working with all areas of clinical services to improve efficiency, communication and collaboration.
* Ensures compliance to accreditation standards, other regulatory standards, quality and initiatives.
* Coordinates the peer review process.
* Provides quality indicator analysis for the physician’s quality incentive program.
* Monitors and keeps abreast of any changes or trends in the healthcare quality area.
* Addresses through the appropriate channels any potential risk and safety issues identified through clinical quality activities.
* Publishes and monitors standards of care for the providers and the nursing department.
* Monitors the provision of quality patient care through the Chief Medical Officer and the Director of Nursing with data from Azara and EHR.
* Evaluates all clinical services and consults with Chief Medical Officer and Quality Committee.
* Supervises the Performance Improvement functions of the Performance Improvement Department.
* Develops and implements standards, goals and initiatives for the Performance Improvement department in coordination with the Deputy Director of Healthcare Quality, Performance Improvement Manager and Chief Medical Officer.
* Responsible for developing, administering, and managing the Center’s performance improvement plan.
* Provides educational support to all FPHC departments with regard to performance improvement
* Monitors and ensures Joint Commission, NCQA and OSV standards of compliance on an ongoing basis, maintaining a constant state of readiness for survey
* Reviews all clinical indicators on a regular basis including but not limited to UDS Quality Measures and makes recommendations as needed to ensure the department’s performance improvement activities are effective.
* Review Performance data presented by PI committee and identify opportunities for improvement and presents findings quarterly to Senior Management.
* Actively participates and/or facilitates committees such as: Performance Improvement, Safety and Infection Control.
* Other duties at the discretion of the Chief Medical Officer.

* Maintains current Alabama Nursing License and board certification. Remains abreast of current employee health practices and guidelines through continuing education classes, journals and professional organizations.
* Attends continuing education classes/webinars related to infection control practices, monitoring and surveillance of infectious disease processes within the organization.
* Attends seminars and continuing education related to Healthcare Quality trends and initiatives.
* Maintains webinars confidentiality.
* Observes and supports Center policies.
* Is prompt and efficient with minimal absences.

Provide assistance in resolving customers’ problems relating to employee services. Coordinates efforts and interfaces with other departments to resolve complaints and patient care deficiencies.

**PERFORMANCE STANDARDS:** Performance will be evaluated by the Chief Medical Officer annually wherein an overall satisfactory rating is considered as a minimum acceptable level of performance.

**HEALTH AND SAFETY REQUIREMENTS:** The health and safety requirements described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job.

* Must adhere to safety regulations, personnel policies and procedures.
* Safety and Hazard Communication training update is required annually.
* Knowledgeable of OSHA and CLIA requirements to assure compliance.
* Maintain yearly health maintenance by obtaining TB skin testing and completion of the hepatitis series.

**PRIVACY RULE COMPLIANCE REQUIREMENTS:**

* Adheres to Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA Privacy Rule) policies and procedures.
* Must successfully complete Privacy Rule compliance training annually or as revisions are made to the policies and procedures.
* Must comply with Privacy Rule guidelines by learning to protect FPHC patient’s medical privacy.
* Must comply with Privacy Rule guidelines by appropriately maintaining our patient information in compliance with national standards.
* Must comply with Privacy Rule guidelines by providing appropriate security of FPHC patient records.

**PROTECTED HEALTH INFORMATION (PHI) ACCESS: RESTRICTED-** For purposes of HIPAA Compliance, there are 4 workforce categories, which define the level of access to PHI that is granted to the incumbent. This position is classified as **PRIMARY PROVIDERS** and therefore granted **UNRESTRICED access**- for the purpose of providing patient care; **RESTRICTED** access for other uses and disclosures, to be defined according to the purpose for which use or disclosure is intended. Use and disclosure must be in accordance with applicable privacy policies and procedures.

Possess strong managerial, administrative, and effective communication skills. Nursing licensed and/or certified professional healthcare quality (CPHQ) in the state of Alabama preferred.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES: Demonstrated clinical competence. Demonstrate appropriate conduct, grooming and sound judgment. Demonstrated ability to work cooperatively and communicate effectively. Good health and consistent attendance. Membership and participation in AL Board of Nursing Association. Possess the ability to delegate duties effectively and efficiently. Ability to read, analyze and interpret clinical data, quality measures, and governmental regulations. Possess ability to write professional reports, letters and procedural manuals. Ability to present information and respond to questions from diverse professional and community groups effectively.

card.title: Director of ICF & Quality Enhancement
card.description:
**Position Summary:** The **Director of ICF & Quality Enhancement** provides direction and hands-on leadership to ensure the effective delivery of assigned programs and services. The Director of ICF & Quality Enhancement is responsible for all activities pertaining to the program’s licensure, human rights, personnel, and contract management obligations for the Fort Lauderdale campus. The Director of ICF & Quality Enhancement will evaluate ASC programs/services, including, but not limited to, the development, implementation, data collection, and analysis of program/services, as well as developing staff training programs, to ensure a standard of quality that serves the organization’s mission to improve the lives of persons supported in compliance with federal, state, and local regulations including licensing requirements which include nursing and nutrition.

**Areas of Responsibility:** 
***A. Program Management (FTL ICF, Nursing and Nutrition): Ensures the delivery of high-quality programs and services in compliance with all federal, state, funding, and city regulations, certifications, and licensing requirements, ASC’s best practices.***

* Provides effective and inspiring leadership, as well as stewardship, of ASC by being actively involved in all programs and services.
* Provides programmatic leadership and input to the CEO for strategic planning purposes.
* Ensure that all program activities operate consistently and ethically within the mission and values of ASC.
* Ensures FTL ICF maintains a safe environment to minimize employee and resident accidents/injuries and unnecessary expenditures.
* Ensures the optimal physical condition of the ICF is appropriately maintained (e.g., furnishings, appliances, grounds, etc.); verifies tickets are submitted in a timely manner to the Maintenance department; follows up with the Facilities Supervisor on outstanding issues, as necessary.
* Ensures Emergency Management Guidelines are followed including, but not limited to timely completion of drills, documentation of drills, maintaining an adequate inventory of emergency supplies, etc.
* Implements and leads a continuous quality improvement process throughout the program and service areas, focusing on systems and process improvement.
* Conducts regular site inspections and regularly attends program meetings to maintain an awareness of day-to-day efforts and needs.
* Arranges, prepares for and participates in all audits and surveys.
* Evaluates programs based upon internal management audits, external survey and audit findings, and specific monitoring data and subsequent analysis; develops new programs as needs emerge.
* Complete all required reports for funding agencies.
* Provide reports on the programmatic status of each program at regularly scheduled meetings;
* Informs the CEO of any programmatic, individual or organizational crisis, or eminent need.
* Submits program updates to the CEO for reporting to the Board; Presents at Board and/or Executive Committee meetings upon request.
* Prepares and submits annual budgets for the department to the CEO for review and approval, manages effectively within these budgets.
* Execute contracts for services and secures CEO and/or Board of Directors’ approval as necessary.
* Assumes responsibility for major projects related to programs and services.
* Conducts home walkthroughs; Ensures the environment is home-like, safe, sanitary, and has adequate supplies to permit service and program delivery to all residents.
* Assures resident’s rights, wishes, desires, and individual needs are met through delivery and Programming.
* Maintains up-to-date knowledge of State and Federal regulations and ensures compliance with rules and regulations.
* Participates in the State, Federal, and quality assurance survey process.
* Ensures the delivery of high-quality nursing care in compliance with established health management and pharmacology procedures.
* Provides oversight to the nutritional department to ensure the delivery of high-quality services to the individuals and program participants.
* Ensure that kitchen and dining room facilities are maintained in compliance with expected standards for the safety and welfare of the residents and the employees.

***B. Quality Assurance and Enhancement (FTL & PPC - ICF, Nursing and Nutrition): Ensures the delivery of high-quality programs and services in compliance with all federal, state, funding, and city regulations, certifications, and licensing requirements, ASC’s best practices.***

* Implements and leads a continuous quality improvement process throughout the program and service areas, focusing on systems and process improvement.
* Periodically reviews services being offered and develops new programs as needs emerge.
* Establish tracking and compliance measures as per contract and/or funding agreement.
* Arranges, prepares and participates in all audits and surveys ensuring the organization is “survey ready.”
* Conducts evaluations of ASC ICF programs/services to ensure overall quality, consistency, compliance with all regulatory requirements, and ASC’s mission and vision
* ***FTL only*** - Prepares and submits annual budgets for each department to the CEO for review and approval, manages effectively within these budgets.
* ***FTL only*** - Assumes responsibility for major projects related to programs and services.
* Implements and manages a system of evaluation services that provides professional development, guidance, education/training and support of ASC staff.
* Maintains up-to-date knowledge of State and Federal regulations and ensures compliance with rules and regulations.
* Develops a monitoring schedule for both campuses with flexibility to provide immediate assistance as requested
* Ensure that the facilities are maintained in compliance with expected standards for the safety and welfare of the residents.

***C. Agency Leadership & Supervisory Duties***

* Establishes and maintains a leadership role within the Agency through implementation of the Annual Plan and timely response to issues and problems and facilitation of crisis circumstances.
* Consults with program leaders regarding the development and/or implementation of Agency Programs and Best Practices; Reviews and updates program-related best practices on an annual basis.
* Reviews and reports progress towards completion of Agency program objectives and goals through meetings and individual conferences.
* Partners with the CEO to represent ASC with external constituency groups, including community, governmental, and private organizations.
* Recruits, trains, and supervises direct reports; Oversees the recruitment, hiring, training, and management of all program staff.
* Defines, clarifies and holds staff accountable to established standards of behavior consistent with ASC’s policies.
* Ensures qualitative interactions between staff and residents.
 + Ensures employees receive timely feedback on their performance.
 + Consults with HR on termination decisions; Participates in the grievance process as required.
 + Ensures rewards and disciplinary actions for staff supervised.
* Assists staff in the development and implementation of coaching and training skills.
 + In-Service training as required.
 + Ensures that management meetings and trainings are held monthly.
 + Attends In-Service training and CEO meetings
 + Develop feedback methods after teaching.
* Ensuring communication with staff about residents’ progress, needs, wishes, and desires is being conducted by Directors and Residential Managers
* Payroll
 + Reviews staff timecards biweekly with Residential Managers to ensure proper clocking in and out, reducing overtime and payroll errors.
 + Monitor overtime report and make required adjustments to reduce costs but ensure we are staying in compliance with the appropriate ratios.
* On Call 24/7; Responds to emergencies appropriately following established procedures.

***D. Executes professional responsibilities effectively and efficiently.***

* Participates in Leadership Meetings to unify departments and programs which will ultimately benefit the Center and the people served.
* Maintains, as needed, consultations with all Circle of Support (COS) members regarding residents’ concerns and/or programs and activities.
* Review minutes of Individual Care Plans (ICP), quarterly reports and attends sampling of meetings throughout the year.
* Receives, reviews, and completes ICP packets for distribution.
* Ensures annual meeting schedule is completed and sent to COS.
* Ensures skill maintenance procedures and check-off sheets are created and forwarded to Records Managers.
* Is responsible for FTL Management monthly meetings and follow-up.
* Provides expertise and input into Homes as requested.
* Compliance with Department of Professional Regulation and Health Department compliance issues.
 + Assists in preparing and implementing plans for quality improvements as needed

**MINIMUM EDUCATION AND WORK EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS:**

* Master’s Degree in human services or a related field; Master’s degree in business administration or related field, accepted
* 7 years of related professional-level experience including five years of senior leadership experience supervising seasoned staff operating multiple human services programs.
* Knowledge of developmental and intellectual disabilities and three years of experience providing direct care to intellectually and/or developmentally disabled individuals.
* Strong relationship builder and communicator with experience leading diverse work teams, developing an organization-wide strategy for program excellence, engaging community partners, and partnering with a CEO and board of directors.
* Personal qualities of integrity, credibility, and commitment to ASC’s mission.
* Demonstrated resourcefulness in setting priorities and guiding people and systems.
* Ability to adapt quickly to unexpected changes, deadlines or business demands and to make sound business judgments independently and under pressure.
* Reliable transportation; Current Florida Motor Vehicle license and automobile insurance with good driving record.
* Ability to travel regularly to provide on-site leadership for multiple operating units and programs.
* Working knowledge of AHCA regulations.
* Computer literate (Microsoft Office and/or Google Workspace).
* Must possess excellent administrative and organizational skills.

**WORKING CONDITIONS:** Standard office environment with moderate noise levels. Variable schedule includes regular business hours, evening and weekends. Regular local travel for meetings, conferences, and events is required. Position is categorized as essential personnel for the purpose of providing disaster services.

**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:** ASC is in full compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) and does not discriminate with regard to applicants or employees with disabilities and will attempt to make reasonable accommodations when necessary. The following are abilities and physical requirements for this position at ASC: 
a. Able to lift 50 lbs. safely and appropriately utilizing standard orientation techniques. 
b. May be exposed to short, intermittent, and/or prolonged periods of sitting, standing, and/or squatting in the performance of job duties. 
c. Must be able to hear see, and communicate effectively in writing, using the English language, with or without reasonable accommodation.
 
d. Ability to work cooperatively with all levels of staff, exercising effective problem-solving, reasoning, and critical thinking skills. 
e. May be required to accomplish job duties using various types of equipment/supplies to include, but not limited to, pens, pencils, calculators, computer keyboards, telephone, etc. 
f. A moderately sedentary position requiring computer and telephone work.

card.title: Regional Director of Operations
card.description:
Advance your career as a Regional Director of Operations (CDM - Certified Dietary Manager) in Illinois, supporting environmental services and food service operations within our healthcare facilities. If you're passionate about mentoring teams and driving excellence across multiple locations, we invite you to apply today.

**As a Regional Director of Operations - Dietary and Environmental Services, you will...** Oversee all assigned facilities, ensuring leadership and guidance in operations, finances, human resources and client relationships, while providing direct supervision to the facility Food Service Directors and Environmental Services Directors. **Must live in the state of Illinois and have previous Healthcare Dietary experience.**

***Key Responsibilities:***

* Actively support and apply all company and facility policies and procedures to ensure the highest quality of service is being provided to our customers at the lowest possible cost.
* Work with Corporate and/or onsite dietitians to ensure that all federal and state requirements are being achieved.
* Cultivate and maintain business partnerships with clients by developing a broad knowledge and understanding of clients’ and their customers’ needs and expectations, including:
* Establish and maintain internal Quality Assurance and Assessment processes in each assigned facility, including inspections, annual client satisfaction surveys, keep the company and its facilities on the cutting edge of our industry.
* Actively participate in food service-related committees within assigned facilities (if applicable), or otherwise be involved in and visible at special events within each assigned facility, to demonstrate the company’s team approach and commitment to the clients
* Plan and develop each unit’s operational budgets and demonstrate an understanding of the company’s financial objectives for each unit. Financial responsibilities include:
* Review financial results weekly and monthly and make necessary adjustments to improve operational performance.
* Develop a weekly financial plan to include sales, menu and production records, food purchases, inventory, and labor productivity to assist each unit in achieving its budget targets.
* Educate Food Service Directors and Environmental Service Directors for each facility in P&L process (where applicable) and review month-end results for each facility.
* Ensure all established accounting practices and timelines are consistently adhered to.
* Provides assistance as needed, with new business bids, rebids for current clients/customers, and the development of new programs, including:
* Renegotiate contract terms and/or fee/pricing increases with client, when necessary.
* Manage transition of new business accounts.
* Conduct audits and evaluate each facility’s performance in the areas of food production, menu and recipe standards, sanitation, uniforms, purchasing, inventories, safety, payroll, human resources compliance and record keeping.
* Demonstrate working knowledge of operational, accounting and human resources policies and procedures (i.e. new hire process, payroll, etc.).
* Ensure all human resources and safety practices and policies are intact and adhered to.
* Hold facility Directors and employees accountable for behavior and performance, following Corrective Action guidelines when necessary.
* Conduct training and development needs assessment of Food Service Directors and arrange necessary training, including the areas of food and cost productions, customer services, team building, time management, human resources skills, etc.
* Communicate with and assist in developing goals and objectives for each Food Service Director. Meet with Directors on an individual basis to assess goals and areas of opportunity.
* Support Directors in conducting training and development needs assessment of employees and assist in arranging appropriate training sessions/tools.
* Ensure companies systems are followed and in compliance daily

**Regional Food Service Director Minimum Requirements:**

* High School diploma (required)
* Certified Dietary Manager (required)
* Multi-site Dietary Operations experience (required)
* Ability to travel within your region frequently (required)
* Minimum 2-5 years’ experience coordinating food service operations
* Bachelor’s degree in culinary arts or related field (preferred, but not required)
* Demonstrated ability to lead and guide teams.
* Strong initiative.
* Strong ability to communicate effectively, both verbally and in writing.
* Ability to maintain confidentiality of records and information.
* Skill in the use of operating basic office equipment.

**Why Join Our Team?**

Whether you’re looking for a **challenge or opportunity for growth as a Certified Dietary Manager** this provides the chance to build your leadership skills in the Healthcare Dietary sector in Environmental Services and Dietary operations, while doing work that truly matters!

### **Brief Job Description**

The Texas Health and Human Services Commission (HHSC) is seeking qualified candidates for a **Director II – Delivery & Operations** position. This role performs highly complex (senior‑level) managerial work focused on maturing and stabilizing delivery governance by enabling teams to deliver predictably, protecting stakeholders from unnecessary disruption, and reinforcing shared accountability.

The Director II works under minimal supervision with extensive latitude for independent judgment and owns domain‑level intake, prioritization, delivery sequencing, and release readiness decisions across the delivery & operation functions. This position is specifically responsible for standardizing delivery processes across multiple teams, addressing inconsistent intake, discovery, and prioritization practices, and improving predictability and confidence for our stakeholders.

This role practices **servant leadership** by removing obstacles, reinforcing clear governance, and enabling teams and stakeholders to operate with confidence and predictability. This role is intentionally designed to begin as an **enabling leader**, establishing consistent delivery flow, governance discipline, and shared operating practices across teams with differing maturity levels. As delivery flow becomes established and reliable, the role transitions to a more **defensive posture**, protecting stable operations and clean releases while maintaining a continuous‑improvement mindset focused on quality, risk management, and stakeholder trust.

### **Essential Job Functions (EJFs)**

#### **Delivery Governance & Standardization (30%)**

* Owns and enforces a single, standardized intake and delivery governance model that enables teams to focus on delivery while reducing ambiguity and rework.
* Addresses and corrects inconsistent intake, prioritization, and sequencing practices.
* Aligns delivery governance between teams with differing maturity levels, leveraging proven practices where performance is stronger.
* Prevents parallel, exception‑based, or ad‑hoc delivery paths that reduce predictability.

#### **Delivery Flow, Sequencing & Enablement (25%)**

* Establishes predictable delivery flow by clearing obstacles, aligning priorities, and creating conditions for teams to succeed.
* Translates stakeholder priorities into clear, sequenced delivery plans.
* Acts as an enabling leader to help teams adopt disciplined delivery practices.
* Gradually transitions from enablement to protection of established flow once stability is achieved.

#### **Release Readiness & Production Stability (20%)**

* Makes domain‑level release readiness decisions to protect stakeholders, teams, and production environments from avoidable risk and disruption.
* Ensures releases are clean, coordinated, and aligned to operational readiness.
* Protects production stability by balancing delivery commitments with operational risk.
* Reduces rework and late‑stage surprises through disciplined governance.

#### **Stakeholder Confidence & Communication (15%)**

* Builds stakeholder confidence by listening actively, setting clear expectations, and ensuring delivery commitments are realistic, transparent, and honored.
* Improves stakeholder confidence through transparency, predictability, and follow‑through.
* Provides clear communication on intake decisions, sequencing, and delivery status.
* Ensures stakeholders experience a consistent delivery model regardless of team.

#### **Escalation & Risk Management (10%)**

* Serves as the escalation boundary between execution teams and department leadership.
* Resolves domain‑level delivery and operational risks independently when possible.
* Escalates only cross‑domain or high‑risk issues to Director III leadership.
* Reduces unnecessary escalation by strengthening governance and decision clarity.

### **Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities (KSAs)**

* Knowledge of delivery governance, intake models, and prioritization in complex environments.
* Knowledge of eligibility systems and operational delivery constraints.
* Skill in removing organizational barriers that impede effective delivery.
* Skill in standardizing processes across teams with varying maturity levels.
* Skill in balancing enablement and enforcement to improve delivery outcomes.
* Ability to lead through **service, trust, and accountability** rather than direct control.
* Ability to balance empathy for teams with responsibility to stakeholders and outcomes.
* Ability to build trust and confidence with program stakeholders.
* Ability to improve delivery flow while protecting operational stability.
* Ability to exercise independent judgment and make sequencing and readiness decisions.
* Ability to lead through governance, clarity, and consistency rather than task management.

### **Initial Screening Criteria**

* Experience leading delivery or operational domains supporting program or eligibility functions.
* Experience improving inconsistent intake, prioritization, or delivery practices.
* Experience standardizing processes across multiple teams.
* Experience working with business or program stakeholders in a service‑delivery environment.
* Experience improving release quality and stakeholder confidence.

### **Registrations, Licensure Requirements, or Certifications**

* Completion of the **AES LEADS Leadership Academy** or similar HHSC leadership development program is preferred, as it supports the leadership, systems‑thinking, and cross‑functional collaboration required for this role.
* IT service management certification (e.g., ITIL 4) – preferred
* Product ownership or portfolio prioritization certification (e.g., CSPO, SAFe POPM) – preferred
* Change management certification (e.g., Prosci) – preferred

### **Additional Information (Standard)**

* Candidates must reside in the State of Texas by their official start date.
* Visa sponsorship is not available for this position.
* Employees must maintain reliable internet connectivity and webcam capability during work hours.
* Selected applicants must pass a background check and other required due diligence.

Review our Tips for Success when applying for jobs at DFPS, DSHS and HHSC.

All active-duty military, reservists, guardsmen, and veterans are encouraged to apply if qualified to fill this position. For more information please see the Texas State Auditor’s Job Descriptions, Military Crosswalk and Military Crosswalk Guide at Texas State Auditor's Office - Job Descriptions.

**ADA Accommodations:**

In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA), HHSC and DSHS agencies will provide reasonable accommodation during the hiring and selection process for qualified individuals with a disability. If you need assistance completing the on-line application, contact the HHS Employee Service Center at 1-888-894-4747. If you are contacted for an interview and need accommodation to participate in the interview process, please notify the person scheduling the interview.
